description: Use this when the user wants to publish, draft or schedule a BLOG ARTICLE on their Shopify store's blog. Publishing costs no credits. Works for the Shopify store connected to this brand (Connectors ▸ Shopify, or connect_shopify_store) or the store this account was installed on. A title is REQUIRED and the text becomes the body: plain text or light markdown (## headings, - lists, **bold**, [links](url)) becomes HTML, and HTML is sent as written. status: publish (default), draft, or scheduled with a future `date`, which Shopify schedules natively. The FIRST image becomes the featured image (Shopify copies it into the store); other images and a video go inside the body by their own links. A store with one blog needs no blog named; with several, pass blog (list_shopify_blogs); newBlogTitle creates a blog with the article. The reply is Shopify's own copy of the article, with its public address once published. An over-long tag is refused, never cut. A store that installed Hermoso before blog posts existed is asked to open the app once and approve the new permission. Shopify has no view counts on a blog article: never quote one.

allowDuplicate.description: post it even though an identical post was just made

blog.description: which blog: title, handle or id (not needed when the store has one)

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE this post belongs to, for THIS CALL ONLY (beats the connection’s pin): an id or exact name from list_brands. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is posted.

date.description: ISO time to publish at; a future date schedules it on Shopify itself

ideaId.description: short id of the content-plan idea this post came from

idempotencyKey.description: any stable string: a repeat within 24h returns the original post instead of posting again

imageUrl.description: one image: becomes the cover (featured) image

imageUrls.description: several images: the first is the cover, the rest go inside the body

newBlogTitle.description: create a new blog with this title and put the article in it

recipe.description: the post's FORMAT id, e.g. "slideshow" or "imessage_chat" — post_performance groups by it, so reuse one id per format

slug.description: the end of the article URL (its handle)

text.description: the body: plain text, light markdown or HTML

videoUrl.description: one video, embedded in the body by its link

name: post_to_shopify_blog
title: Publish a Shopify blog article
